name: MP Candlestick
summary: This EA identifies and trades based on Japanese candlestick patterns on the chart. It scans for specific reversal or continuation patterns and automatically opens positions when a qualifying pattern is detected, with configurable lot sizing and stop loss/take profit levels.
summary_zh: 该EA基于日本K线形态进行识别和交易。它扫描特定的反转或持续形态，在检测到符合条件的K线形态时自动开仓，并支持可配置的手数大小和止损/止盈水平。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是基于经典日本K线形态识别进行交易决策，属于技术分析中形态识别类策略。入场条件为识别到特定的K线反转形态（如锤子线、吞没形态、晨星/暮星等）时开仓做多或做空。出场条件通常依赖固定止损和止盈参数，也可能结合形态目标位进行平仓。仓位管理采用固定手数方式，未发现动态仓位调整或基于ATR的自适应止损机制。资金管理方面较为简单，依赖用户手动设置合理的风险参数，缺乏自动风险比例计算。整体而言，该策略依赖于K线形态的统计优势，但在趋势市场中可能出现连续假信号导致多次止损。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is based on classic Japanese candlestick pattern recognition for trading decisions, falling under the pattern recognition category of technical analysis. Entry conditions trigger when specific candlestick reversal patterns (such as hammer, engulfing, morning/evening star, etc.) are detected, opening long or short positions accordingly. Exit conditions typically rely on fixed stop loss and take profit parameters, and may also incorporate pattern-based price targets for closing positions. Position sizing uses a fixed lot approach, with no dynamic position adjustment or ATR-based adaptive stop loss mechanism found. Money management is relatively simple, relying on the user to manually set reasonable risk parameters, lacking automatic risk-ratio calculation. Overall, the strategy depends on the statistical edge of candlestick patterns, but may encounter consecutive false signals in trending markets leading to multiple stop losses.

parameters.description_en: Fixed lot size (if not using dynamic position sizing)

parameters.description: EA专属魔术编号，用于区分订单
parameters.description_en: EA magic number for order identification

pros: K线形态是经典技术分析方法，具有广泛的市场认知度和历史验证
策略逻辑直观易懂，交易信号有明确的图表形态支撑
参数较少，配置简单，适合初学者使用和调试
pros_en: Candlestick patterns are a classic technical analysis method with broad market recognition and historical validation
Strategy logic is intuitive and easy to understand, with trading signals supported by clear chart patterns
Few parameters and simple configuration make it suitable for beginners to use and debug
cons: K线形态在震荡市和趋势市中假信号较多，缺乏趋势过滤器
仓位管理为固定手数，未实现基于账户余额或波动率的动态风险管理
缺少新K线检查机制，可能在同一根K线上重复开仓
止损止盈为固定点数，未考虑不同品种和时段的波动率差异
cons_en: Candlestick patterns produce many false signals in both ranging and trending markets, lacking a trend filter
Position sizing is fixed lot, without dynamic risk management based on account balance or volatility
Lacks a new bar check mechanism, which may cause repeated position openings on the same bar
Stop loss and take profit are fixed pip values, not accounting for volatility differences across instruments and timeframes
improvements: 增加趋势过滤器（如均线方向或ADX指标），仅在趋势方向上交易反转形态以减少假信号
实现基于ATR的自适应止损止盈和动态仓位管理，提高风险管理的适应性
improvements_en: Add a trend filter (such as moving average direction or ADX indicator) to only trade reversal patterns in the trend direction, reducing false signals
Implement ATR-based adaptive stop loss/take profit and dynamic position sizing to improve risk management adaptability

risk_points: 固定止损止盈未考虑市场波动率变化，在高波动时段可能止损过小导致频繁止损
缺少新K线检查可能导致同一信号重复开仓放大风险
K线形态假信号较多，无过滤机制可能导致连续亏损
risk_points_en: Fixed stop loss/take profit does not account for market volatility changes; small stops during high volatility periods may cause frequent stop-outs
Lack of new bar check may cause repeated position opening on the same signal, amplifying risk
Candlestick patterns have many false signals; absence of filtering mechanism may lead to consecutive losses

summary_en: This EA identifies and trades based on Japanese candlestick patterns on the chart. It scans for specific reversal or continuation patterns and automatically opens positions when a qualifying pattern is detected, with configurable lot sizing and stop loss/take profit levels.
